el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-addon-dev.description: Write Blender 5.2 add-ons as extensions - blender_manifest.toml, operators/panels/menus/property groups/preferences, bpy.props rules after 5.0, undo/redo, modal and timer patterns, gpu drawing (no bgl), bundling Python wheels, CLI validate/build/install, testing headless, extensions platform publishing. Use when creating or fixing a Blender add-on, tool, or UI.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-addon-dev.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-animation.description: Animation in Blender 5.2 - slotted/layered actions and the channelbag API, Python keyframing, F-curves, game loops, NLA clips, pose library, mocap/BVH retargeting via constraints, baking control rigs to export skeletons, root motion, per-clip export. Use for any keyframe, action, NLA, mocap, or animation-export task.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-animation.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-asset-qa.description: Mandatory review gate for any mesh or asset created or edited in Blender. Detects z-fighting (coplanar overlaps), floating/detached parts, inverted or inconsistent normals, non-manifold/open geometry, degenerate faces, duplicate verts, n-gons, unapplied scale, UV problems, bad skin weights, and renders multi-angle review sheets. Use before calling any modeling, export or delivery task done.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-asset-qa.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-character.description: Character rigging in Blender 5.2 - Rigify metarig fit/generate, bone naming/roll/collections, DEF/MCH/control layers, IK/FK, robust skinning (heat + proxy fallback), weight-painting rules, correctives, engine game skeletons (Unity, Unreal, Roblox R15), rig validation and deformation stress tests. Use for armature, skinning or weights tasks.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-character.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-core.description: Foundation for any Blender 5.2+ task an agent drives - running bpy via MCP (live) or headless CLI, context overrides, locale-safe node lookup, enum discovery, 5.x API changes, verification. Use first for any Blender, bpy, .blend or 3D-asset request; routes to the specialized blender-* skills.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-core.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-export-pi.description: Export from Blender 5.2 with verified presets - Roblox (FBX/glTF, cages, R15, SurfaceAppearance), Unity (FBX, Humanoid), Unreal (FBX skeletal, Nanite, UCX), Godot/web (GLB, meshopt/Draco, WebP), USD. Scale/axes, smoothing, tangents, leaf bones, clips, batch export, post-export verification. Use whenever an asset leaves Blender.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-export-pi.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-facial-sh.description: Facial rigs and shape keys in Blender 5.2 - ARKit 52 blendshapes, visemes for lip-sync, sculpting expressions, splitting symmetric shapes into Left/Right, mirroring, corrective and combination shapes, drivers and control rigs, bone+blendshape hybrids, export to engines (Unity, Unreal, Roblox dynamic heads, VRM/web). Use for faces, expressions, lip-sync, or any shape-key work.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-facial-sh.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-game-opti.description: Optimize Blender assets for real-time engines - triangle/material/texture/bone budgets per platform (mobile, Roblox, web, VR, console, PC), LOD chains, decimation modes, mesh cleanup, draw-call reduction (material merging, atlases, trim sheets), instancing, vertex-split costs, collision proxies, texture memory. Use when an asset is too heavy, before export, or when targeting a platform budget.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-game-opti.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-geometry-.description: Geometry Nodes in Blender 5.2 - fields, domains, attributes, instancing, zones (simulation/repeat/for-each), closures/bundles, lists, SDF grids, node tools, baking, plus a JSON-to-node-tree builder and socket inspector. Use for scattering, procedural assets/environments, parametric tools and modifier inputs.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-geometry-.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-hardsurfa.description: Hard-surface and prop modeling in Blender 5.2 - blockout-to-detail flow, non-destructive modifier stacks (Mirror, Boolean Exact/Manifold, Bevel, Weighted Normal, Smooth by Angle), mid-poly vs subdivision vs high-to-low workflows, shading/custom normals, cylinder segment budgets, edge attributes from Python. Use for weapons, vehicles, props, architecture, mechanical parts.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-hardsurfa.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-lighting-.description: Lighting, cameras and look-dev in Blender 5.2 - studio 3-point and product lighting, HDRI environments, sun/sky exteriors, interiors, light linking, physically based light units, camera focal lengths/composition/DOF, cyclorama backdrops, looping turntables for asset presentation. Use when presenting assets, setting up scenes for rendering, or judging materials under consistent light.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-lighting-.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-pbr-mater.description: Physically based materials in Blender 5.2 - metal/roughness rules, Principled BSDF inputs, color spaces (sRGB vs Non-Color), measured albedo/F0 values, texture-set auto-wiring, ORM channel packing, DirectX vs OpenGL normals, alpha modes, displacement, view transforms (AgX, Khronos PBR Neutral), engine-ready material rules. Use when creating, fixing, or exporting materials and textures.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-pbr-mater.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-pipeline-.description: Automate Blender 5.2 at scale - headless CLI flags, batch convert/inventory/run-any-skill-script over folders of .blend/.fbx/.glb/.obj/.usd, sharding, bpy pip module, library linking, path management, render-farm and CI patterns. Use for batch jobs, format conversion, library maintenance and pipeline tooling.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-pipeline-.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-rendering.description: Render with Blender 5.2 Cycles/EEVEE/Workbench - quality presets, GPU setup, adaptive sampling, denoising, light paths, color management (AgX, Khronos PBR Neutral, ACES), PNG/EXR/MP4 output, passes, the 5.0 compositor API, CLI and multi-camera batch rendering. Use for any still, animation or turntable render.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-rendering.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-retopolog.description: Retopology and UVs in Blender 5.2 - auto retopo (Quadriflow, Decimate, planar), deformation edge flow, seams, unwrap (Angle Based, Minimum Stretch, Smart), pixel-margin packing, texel density measure/set, lightmap UV2, UDIMs, mirrored UVs. Use to turn sculpts/scans/AI meshes into game meshes or prep UVs for texturing/baking.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-retopolog.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-scene-set.description: Set up and audit Blender scenes the way studios do - units and real-world scale, collection layout, naming conventions (SM_/SK_/T_/M_), origins, linking vs appending, library overrides, asset libraries and catalogs, collection exporters, orphan/path cleanup. Use when starting a project, organizing a .blend, or before handoff/export.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-scene-set.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-sculpting.description: Sculpting in Blender 5.2 - base-to-detail workflow, voxel remesh, dyntopo, multires, 5.x brush types, masks/face sets, symmetry, plus headless-safe procedural ops for agents (remesh, symmetrize, multires, inflate, noise detail, smooth) and the sculpt-to-game handoff. Use for organic models, characters, creatures, rocks and bake sources.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-sculpting.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-simulatio.description: Physics in Blender 5.2 - rigid bodies (density mass, shapes, bake to keys), classic cloth presets and pinning, new node-based Cloth/Hair Dynamics (XPBD, Collider, effectors), Mantaflow fluids, hair curves, GN simulation zones, headless baking. Use for destruction, drapes, flags, falling objects, liquids, smoke, hair motion.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-simulatio.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-texture-b.description: Bake texture maps in Blender 5.2 Cycles - high-to-low normal maps with cage/extrusion, AO, curvature, ID, thickness, base color/roughness/metallic from procedurals, ORM packing, OpenGL vs DirectX, margins, GPU baking, fixing skewing/waviness/seams. Use when transferring sculpt or high-poly detail to game meshes or converting procedural materials to textures.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-texture-b.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-time-of-d.description: Time of day and atmosphere in Blender 5.2 - measured sky + sun for dawn, morning, noon, golden hour, sunset, blue hour, overcast, night/moonlight with stars and city glow, exposure balance, height fog from visibility, god rays, Cycles vs EEVEE volumes, compositor grade, stylized moods (cyberpunk neon, horror, underwater, desert). Use for any day/night, sunset, foggy or mood lighting scene.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-time-of-d.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-weather-f.description: Weather effects in Blender 5.2 - looping Geometry Nodes rain, snow, dust, ash and embers with ground hits and splashes, wet surfaces, puddles with animated ripples, wall streaks, snow cover (shader + real snow geometry), storm lightning with multi-stroke flashes and bolts, engine-ready weather masks. Use for rain, storm, snow, wet street, puddle, dust or ember scenes.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-weather-f.author: blender-agent-skills

el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-workflow-.description: End-to-end Blender 5.2 playbooks chaining the blender-* skills with QA gates - game props (mid-poly, high-to-low), game characters (sculpt/AI mesh to rigged, animated export), Roblox props/accessories/avatars, AI or downloaded asset cleanup, procedural environments, web/AR assets, product turntables, mood/weather shots (night, rain, snow, fog). Use for complete multi-stage asset requests.
el4cteo-blender-skills-blender-workflow-.author: blender-agent-skills
